note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the OT renderings made in its register: Moody's cited verses (Luke 2:10-11, Isaiah 49:24-25, Job 33:24-28, Nehemiah 9:15, James 1:5, Matthew 11:28-29), the refrains he returns to (John 14:6, Psalm 23:1, Romans 8:32), and the phrases he quotes inside his own sentences.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Inner quotations inside a speaker's words take ‹ ›. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are Moody's own adaptations of a verse.

Judgement calls. The sermon's theme word 'Saviour' stays መድኃኒት in Moody's prose, while Luke 2:11 is quoted as OWB has it («አዳኝ»). Job 33:24-28 is OWB's plural wording, joined with '…' over verse 27 as the English skips it. 'Our all in all' is quoted as Colossians 3:11, OWB «ክርስቶስ ሁሉ ነው፤ በሁሉም ውስጥ አለ». Moody's 'set your affections on things above' is OWB Colossians 3:2 whole. 'Living epistles, known and read of all men' quotes OWB 2 Corinthians 3:2's «ሰው ሁሉም ሊያውቀውና ሊያነበው» with Moody's 'living epistle' around it.
